data_layer_agent.description: Responsible for the Data Access Layer. Implements CRUD operations and complex reordering logic in DatabaseRepository using Drift. Runs build_runner to generate code.

home_feature_agent.description: Responsible for the Home feature. Implements the HomeScreen to list boards and the functionality to create new boards.

board_feature_agent.description: Responsible for the Board feature. Implements the BoardScreen, the horizontal list of tasks, vertical list of cards, and the Drag & Drop functionality.

card_feature_agent.description: Responsible for the Card details. Implements the CardDetailScreen for editing titles, descriptions, and other card properties.

phases.name: Data Layer Implementation
phases.description: Setup database repositories and ensure all CRUD and reordering methods are available.

steps.description: Implement DatabaseRepository with getBoards, createBoard, deleteBoard, getLists, createList, updateListPosition, getCards, createCard, updateCardPosition, moveCard. Run 'dart run build_runner build -d' to generate code. Update router.json with app routes.

phases.name: Feature Implementation
phases.description: Build the main screens of the application.

steps.description: Implement HomeScreen. Use Riverpod to fetch boards from DatabaseRepository. Add FAB to create new board.
Implement BoardScreen scaffold. Fetch lists and cards for the specific board. Display lists horizontally. Allow creating new lists.

phases.name: Interactions & Details
phases.description: Add Drag & Drop and Card Details.

steps.description: Implement Drag & Drop for Cards and Lists. Use LongPressDraggable and DragTarget. Update positions in DatabaseRepository on drop.
Implement CardDetailScreen. Allow editing title and description. Connect to GoRouter /board/:id/card/:cardId.

metadata.description: Workflow for building a Trello Clone in Flutter with Riverpod, Drift, and Drag & Drop.
